# City vehicle model attribution

These are artist replicas of existing cars, not manufacturer CAD. Added city vehicles are excluded from the five-car landing experiment. Their rounded wheelbases and class masses are explicitly simulation assumptions. Body envelopes are measured from the scaled mesh; handling is the shared simulator, not a tested model of each production car.

Asset delivery: [pedrosoandre/carros](https://github.com/pedrosoandre/carros) at commit 2d18dfd9db96bbf0d9cffa949deaf7f571388cbf. Original GLB bytes remain unchanged. Runtime changes: metric scaling, four wheel pivots, neutral parked steering, brakes/fixed suspension mapping where separate, color changes, shared hypothetical cold-gas hardware. All model licenses were checked against the original Sketchfab model API; source descriptions were reviewed for conflicting/restricted upstream provenance. See city-fleet-provenance.json for hashes and snapshots.
